title: A trainer class: data/trainer_classes/<class>.json
description: A trainer class's text, in the order of data/constants/trainer_classes.txt. The text files take it with \from{trainer_classes.name} and \from{trainer_classes.name_with_article} (tools/text/text_sources.py).

compress_name.description: Whether the name is stored compressed, as the game stores some of them; left out, it isn't

name_with_article.description: The name with its article, as "a Youngster", or as the game has it where it has none, as "Lenora", or another form, as "a Twin"
